theme: Storing secrets safely: the keychain, SecItemAdd and SecItemCopyMatching

terms.definition: A secure storage system on the device for small secrets like passwords and tokens.
terms.example: Store the refresh token in the keychain.
terms.code:
import Security
let kind = kSecClassGenericPassword
let q = [kSecClass: kind]
print(q.count)  // ask for passwords

terms.definition: The function that saves a new item, such as a password, into the keychain.
terms.example: Call SecItemAdd to save the token.
terms.code:
import Foundation
import Security
let q = [kSecClass: kSecClassGenericPassword]
func save() { SecItemAdd(q as CFDictionary, nil) }
print(q.count)

terms.definition: The function that searches the keychain and returns the item that matches your query.
terms.example: Use SecItemCopyMatching to read the saved token.
terms.code:
import Foundation
import Security
let q: [CFString: Any] = [
    kSecClass: kSecClassGenericPassword,
    kSecAttrService: "no.such.app"]
print(SecItemCopyMatching(q as CFDictionary, nil))

video.description:
Learn to explain storing passwords and tokens safely: Keychain, SecItemAdd & SecItemCopyMatching, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Keychain - A secure storage system on the device for small secrets like passwords and tokens.
SecItemAdd - The function that saves a new item, such as a password, into the keychain.
SecItemCopyMatching - The function that searches the keychain and returns the item that matches your query.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Keychain, SecItemAdd & SecItemCopyMatching in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Keychain, SecItemAdd, SecItemCopyMatching 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Keychain - A secure storage system on the device for small secrets like passwords and tokens.
한국어: Keychain: 비밀번호와 토큰 같은 작은 비밀을 기기에 안전하게 저장하는 시스템

SecItemAdd - The function that saves a new item, such as a password, into the keychain.
한국어: SecItemAdd: 비밀번호 같은 새 항목을 키체인에 저장하는 함수

SecItemCopyMatching - The function that searches the keychain and returns the item that matches your query.
한국어: SecItemCopyMatching: 키체인을 검색해서 쿼리와 일치하는 항목을 돌려주는 함수

landscape.hook: Can you explain Keychain, SecItemAdd and SecItemCopyMatching in English?

dialogue.title: Where to keep the token
dialogue.setting: Choosing a place for a login token

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, where do I store the user's token? UserDefaults feels wrong.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the keychain. It is secure storage for small secrets like passwords and tokens.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, the system protects it, and other apps cannot read your items.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I save something into it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Call SecItemAdd with a query. It saves a new item.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, `add` is just SecItemAdd. And SecItemCopyMatching reads the item back.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. SecItemCopyMatching returns the item that matches, or an error if there is none.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And does the token stay after an app update?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, the keychain keeps it, so users stay logged in.

dialogue.code:
import Security
let add = SecItemAdd
let find = SecItemCopyMatching
// both return an OSStatus
